summary: Wrote the standalone homily (1,377 spoken words, about 10.6-11.5 minutes at 130-120 wpm, untimed) for an adult parish assembly: the third interpretation (the clay and the faithful potter) joined with the second (the watch at the door) as the study's comparison joins them. It moves from Mark 13:37 and Augustine's Letter 199 through Isaiah's people who confess that none calls on God's name and then call him Father (Is 64:6-7, with Jerome on patience and on the clay), the psalm refrain with Augustine 79.3 and the Collect's petition for a will, Bede's servants and door of the heart, and Paul's thanks for the Corinthians with Chrysostom on 'God is faithful', to one response (name one's sleep in confession and call God Father, with Augustine 84.15) and the Preface's watchers, ending on 1 Cor 1:8-9. Declared [document.homily], generated homily.tex, wrote the terminal note with References, the contribution line and the production record; all author checks pass.
